domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n greater than 1
t is a real number satisfying (n-1)/n is at most t
t is a real number with t strictly less than 1
k is an integer with k at least 1
k is an integer with k at most n
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n greater than 1, for all real numbers t with (n-1)/n <= t and t < 1, and for all integers k with 1 <= k <= n, floor of (k times t) equals k minus 1; therefore E_n(t) equals H_n minus 1.

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer universal parameter controlling the range of t and k

variables.name: t
variables.role: real scaling parameter used in k*t

variables.name: k
variables.role: index parameter in the floor(k*t) expression

witness_dependencies: No existential witnesses are introduced; all variables (n, t, k) are universally quantified
The allowable range of t depends on n via the bound (n-1)/n

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with (n-1)/n <= t < 1, one has floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, and hence E_n(t) = H_n - 1.
